name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: Quantity control whose number rolls — each changed digit slides out as the new one slides in, up or down with the change. Airbnb-style outline, an iOS-style filled capsule, a compact row control, and a DoorDash-style cart button that springs open from a single + into − 1 + (with a trash can at 1). Buttons spring on press, hold to repeat with acceleration, and pushing past a limit gives a little bump.
props: Limits; the matching button dims and a press past it bumps the number.

Round outlined buttons, one tinted capsule, an accent cart button that collapses to + at 0, or small tinted buttons. Old names still work: default → outline, pill / segmented → filled, vertical → filled + vertical.
32 / 36 / 44pt buttons (touch area always ≥ 44pt); the number and icons scale too. compact is always 28pt.
Display format, e.g. currency; every changed character rolls.
Muted unit after the number: "kg", or (n) => n === 1 ? "night" : "nights".
cart: text beside the + while collapsed, e.g. "Add".
Hold to keep stepping, speeding up.
Title on the left; the control moves to the right edge.
Read by screen readers; the control is adjustable (swipe up / down).
The control, or the whole row when label / description is set.
Applied to the number (fontSize, colour, weight).
